title: IncomeCertificateExtractionSchema
description: Schema for structured data extraction from annual income certificate issued by Nepal ward office.

letter_no.description: Letter number exactly as printed near the top left (e.g. '2082/83'). Extract all digits and slashes verbatim. Return an empty string if absent.

ref_no.description: Reference number exactly as printed (e.g. '303'), top-left below the letter number. Return an empty string if absent.

date.description: Certificate issuance date, formatted exactly as printed in the top right (e.g. '2025-11-04'). Return in that exact form.

office_name.description: Full English office title as printed at the top center, e.g. 'Nagarjun Municipality 10 No. Ward Office'. Include municipality and ward designation exactly as in the source.

municipality.description: Municipality name as printed in the header, e.g. 'Nagarjun Municipality'.

ward_no.description: Ward number as printed in the header, e.g. '10'.

district.description: District name as printed in the office title or subject section, e.g. 'Kathmandu'.

province.description: Province name as found in the header description: e.g. 'Bagmati Province'. Return as printed.

subject.description: Certificate subject heading as printed, e.g. 'Annual Income Certificate'.

certificate_holder.description: Full name of the certificate holder (i.e., for whom the income is being certified), as printed in the body after 'This is to certify that ...'.

certificate_holder_father.description: Full name of the certificate holder's father, as printed in the body after 'son of'. Return as printed.

certificate_holder_mother.description: Full name of the certificate holder's mother, as printed in the body after 'and'. Return as printed.

certificate_holder_grandfather.description: Full name of the certificate holder's grandfather, as printed in the body after 'grandson of'. Return as printed.

holder_local_address.description: Local address of the certificate holder (usually municipality, ward, district, province) as described after 'a permanent resident of ...'.

income_sources.description: List of income sources and family members as tabular records in the certificate table. Each array entry corresponds to a table row.

sn.description: Serial number as printed in the S.N. column (e.g. '1', '2').

owner_name.description: Owner's name as printed in the Owner's Name column.

relation.description: Relation to the certificate holder as printed (e.g. 'mother of Mr. Aaditya Joshi').

source_of_income.description: Text from the Sources of Income column (e.g. 'Income from salary').

annual_income.description: Numeric value of annual income, exactly as printed (e.g. '420000').

remarks.description: Remarks column text as printed. Return all content verbatim.

total_income_nrs.description: The total annual income in NPR, as printed, from the 'Total Income in NRs' row.

total_income_aud.description: The total income in AUD as printed in the 'Total Income in AUD' row.

total_income_nrs_words.description: Total annual income in NRs written out in words, as printed under the table in the summary section (e.g. 'Fourty Four Lakh Fourty Thousand Only').

todays_aud_rate.description: Today's buying rate as printed: 'Today's Buying Rate 1 AUD = NRs. ...', just the numeric rate to two decimals.

total_income_aud_words.description: Equivalent AUD total written in words, as in the summary portion (e.g. 'Fourty Seven Thousand Eight Hundred Twenty Four and 21/100').

ward_chairperson_name.description: Name of the ward chairperson or signing authority, as printed or handwritten at the bottom, above title.

ward_chairperson_title.description: Title of ward chairperson, usually 'Ward Chairperson', as printed under the signature at the bottom.
